g.text: Technical APIs represent technical dependencies between applications
or teams. Often they are designed as point-to-point interfaces, covering
a speciﬁc aspect of a business capability, and thereby symptomatically
have a very low reuse coeﬃcient.
Domain APIs expose a reusable domain API, but they need deep domain
expertise to be used correctly. They require a complex ramp-up process for
Managed APIs are services with consumer oriented design, hiding internal
complexities and providing comprehensive documentation. They provide an easy-to-
use, but still managed, self-service process for simple onboarding of new consumers.
Consumer driven APIs are managed APIs that focus on the ability to react on consumer
demands within some days instead of months and thus aim to achieve a high reuse
coeﬃcient while still implementing a high rate of changes.
